, if DNA repair is compromised, the organism is more likely to be cancerous.

the repair of DNA damage is essential for the survival of the organism.

the DNA‐repair pathways are essential for the maintenance of genome integrity, and that defects in these pathways are often linked to cancer and other diseases, including neurodegeneration and aging.
